name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet supported on the floor and eyes below the bar. Use a closed grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
With a spotter, unrack the bar and position it above your chest with your wrists aligned over your forearms.
Lower the bar under control toward the middle of your chest, keeping your shoulders supported on the bench.
Press the bar upward while exhaling. After the final repetition, return it securely to the rack with assistance.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Lifting the hips from the bench or losing wrist alignment.
tips: Choose a load you can control throughout the movement.
Use a spotter and appropriately positioned safety supports.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Set a bar across your upper back, brace your trunk and stand with feet comfortably apart.
Bend your knees and hips together, keeping your feet planted; stand back up with control.
mistakes: Avoid letting your knees collapse inward.
tips: Use rack safeties and a depth you can control.

name: Seated hip adduction
instructions: Adjust the seat and pads so your inner thighs contact the pads and your back is supported.
Bring your legs together slowly, then allow them to open without dropping the stack.
mistakes: Avoid forcing your legs into an uncomfortable starting width.
tips: Keep your pelvis still.

name: Air bike
instructions: Adjust the saddle to allow a slight knee bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal while pushing and pulling the handles at a sustainable pace.
mistakes: Avoid rocking your hips to reach the pedals.
tips: Start gradually before increasing effort.

name: Battle ropes
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand with knees softly bent and your trunk braced.
Alternate lifting and lowering your arms to create waves while keeping a stable stance.
mistakes: Avoid leaning back or shrugging with every wave.
tips: Use small controlled waves before increasing speed.

name: Bench dip
instructions: Place your hands on a secure bench beside your hips, with your feet on the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower a short, comfortable distance, then press through your hands to return.
mistakes: Avoid sinking into a deep shoulder stretch.
tips: Keep your hips close to the bench.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly supporting your head.
Rotate your trunk toward one knee as the other leg extends; alternate sides slowly.
mistakes: Avoid pulling on your neck.
tips: Move through your trunk rather than only your elbows.

name: Box jump
instructions: Stand in front of a stable box of a manageable height with a clear landing area.
Bend your knees, swing your arms and jump onto the box; land softly, stand tall and step down.
mistakes: Avoid choosing a height that forces a deep, unstable landing.
tips: Reset your stance before each jump.

name: Box squat
instructions: Set a stable box inside a rack and position the bar across your upper back.
Sit back and down with control until you lightly contact the box, then stand without rocking.
mistakes: Avoid dropping onto the box.
tips: Keep your trunk braced during the pause.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Hold dumbbells by your sides and rest your rear foot on a stable bench.
Bend your front knee to lower your body, then push through the front foot to stand.
mistakes: Avoid pushing mainly with your rear leg.
tips: Choose a stance that lets your front heel stay down.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with space around you, then lower your hands to the floor.
Step or jump your feet back into a plank, return them toward your hands and stand or jump upward.
mistakes: Avoid letting your lower back sag in the plank.
tips: Step through the movement to reduce impact.

name: Cable curl
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand upright with your elbow near your side.
Bend your elbow to curl the handle upward, then lower it slowly.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your torso to lift the handle.
tips: Keep your upper arm mostly still.

name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Stand beside a low cable with the handle in the outside hand and a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arm out to the side to a comfortable height, then lower with control.
mistakes: Avoid shrugging or leaning to lift the load.
tips: Lead with the elbow and keep your wrist relaxed.

name: Cable pull-through
instructions: Face away from a low cable with the rope between your legs and feet planted apart.
Push your hips backward with soft knees, then extend your hips to stand tall.
mistakes: Avoid turning the movement into a deep squat.
tips: Finish upright without leaning backward.

name: Cable crossover
instructions: Stand between cable handles with a stable stance and elbows slightly bent.
Bring your arms forward in an arc, then open them slowly within a comfortable shoulder range.
mistakes: Avoid changing your elbow bend dramatically during the movement.
tips: Keep your rib cage over your pelvis.

name: Cable woodchop
instructions: Stand sideways to a high cable with both hands on the handle.
Guide the handle diagonally across your body while allowing a controlled turn through your hips and trunk.
mistakes: Avoid twisting suddenly against a heavy load.
tips: Keep the motion smooth in both directions.

name: Standing dumbbell calf raise
instructions: Stand upright holding dumbbells with your feet stable and parallel.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower your heels slowly.
mistakes: Avoid bouncing at the bottom.
tips: Use a support for balance if needed.

name: Chest-supported machine row
instructions: Adjust the machine so your chest rests comfortably against the pad and grasp the handles.
Pull the handles toward your torso, then extend your arms under control.
mistakes: Avoid lifting your chest off the pad.
tips: Let your shoulder blades move with the pull.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above your chest and elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a controlled arc, then bring them back above your chest.
mistakes: Avoid lowering beyond a comfortable shoulder stretch.
tips: Use a light load and maintain the elbow bend.

name: Close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with feet planted and take a closed grip around shoulder width.
Lower the bar toward your chest with elbows near your torso, then press upward under control.
mistakes: Avoid bringing your hands so close that your wrists bend sharply.
tips: Use a spotter and rack safeties.

name: Concentration curl
instructions: Sit with feet apart and support the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, then lower it slowly.
mistakes: Avoid moving your whole shoulder to finish the repetition.
tips: Keep your wrist aligned with your forearm.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Curl your shoulders slightly off the floor, then lower them with control.
mistakes: Avoid pulling your head forward with your hands.
tips: Exhale gently as you curl up.

name: Stationary cycling
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal smoothly at a manageable resistance while keeping your upper body relaxed.
mistakes: Avoid setting the saddle so low that your knees remain deeply bent.
tips: Build pace gradually.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells with palms facing forward and elbows near your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders, then lower them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your hips for momentum.
tips: Keep your upper arms steady.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline and hold dumbbells near the upper chest.
Press the weights upward, then lower them with control while keeping your back supported.
mistakes: Avoid flaring your elbows to an uncomfortable angle.
tips: Keep your feet planted and wrists stacked over your forearms.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench while the other foot stays planted on the floor.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, then lower it while keeping your torso steady.
mistakes: Avoid rotating your whole trunk to lift the weight.
tips: Think of drawing your elbow backward.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Stand with your trunk braced and dumbbells near shoulder level.
Press the weights overhead within a comfortable range, then lower them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid leaning backward to finish the press.
tips: Keep your ribs over your pelvis.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent and arms reaching toward the ceiling.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm, return and switch sides.
mistakes: Avoid arching your lower back as the limbs extend.
tips: Shorten the reach if your trunk starts to move.

name: Parallel-bar dip
instructions: Support yourself on stable parallel bars with shoulders controlled and arms extended.
Bend your elbows to lower within a comfortable shoulder range, then press back up.
mistakes: Avoid sinking deeply into the shoulders.
tips: Use assistance if you cannot control the descent.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and dumbbells above your chest.
Lower until your upper arms gently meet the floor, then press the weights upward.
mistakes: Avoid bouncing your arms off the floor.
tips: Keep wrists aligned above elbows.

name: Elliptical trainer
instructions: Step onto the stationary pedals, hold the handles and stand upright.
Move the pedals smoothly and adjust resistance to a sustainable effort.
mistakes: Avoid supporting most of your body weight on the handles.
tips: Begin at a slow pace to find the rhythm.

name: Cable face pull
instructions: Set a rope handle around upper-chest or face height and stand with a stable stance.
Pull the rope toward your face with hands separating, then return slowly.
mistakes: Avoid leaning backward to move the stack.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and shoulders controlled.

name: Kettlebell farmer carry
instructions: Stand between two kettlebells, brace and lift them using a controlled hip and knee bend.
Walk with small steady steps, then lower the weights safely.
mistakes: Avoid leaning to one side or holding your breath for the entire carry.
tips: Keep the path clear before starting.

name: Front squat
instructions: Set the bar across the front of your shoulders in a secure front-rack position.
Bend knees and hips into a controlled squat, then stand while keeping your elbows elevated.
mistakes: Avoid letting the bar roll into your hands as your elbows drop.
tips: Use rack safeties and a manageable load.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips, then lower them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid overextending your lower back at the top.
tips: Finish with your ribs and pelvis aligned.

name: Cable glute kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and hold a stable support.
Extend the working hip to move your leg backward, then return without swinging.
mistakes: Avoid arching your back to lift the leg higher.
tips: Keep your pelvis facing forward.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell close to your chest and set your feet comfortably apart.
Sit down between your hips with heels planted, then stand up.
mistakes: Avoid collapsing your knees inward.
tips: Keep the weight close to your torso.

name: Hack squat
instructions: Position your back and shoulders against the machine pads with feet secure on the platform.
Release the safety handles, bend your knees to lower, then press the platform away to return.
mistakes: Avoid lifting your heels or pelvis off their supports.
tips: Learn the safety stops before loading the machine.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells by your sides and palms facing inward.
Bend your elbows to raise the weights, then lower slowly with the same grip.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your shoulders forward.
tips: Keep your wrists neutral.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang securely from a pull-up bar with shoulders controlled.
Bring your knees toward your trunk, then lower them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your legs for momentum.
tips: Start each repetition from a still position.

name: Barbell hip thrust
instructions: Support your upper back on a stable bench with a padded bar across your hips and feet planted.
Drive your hips upward, then lower under control.
mistakes: Avoid leaning your head backward or overextending your spine.
tips: Finish with your torso and thighs aligned.

name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Lie on your back, brace your abdomen and lift your shoulders slightly.
Extend your arms and legs only as far as you can while maintaining a stable lower back; hold and breathe.
mistakes: Avoid letting your lower back arch.
tips: Bend your knees to make the hold easier.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles with elbows near your sides and clear space around you.
Turn the rope from your wrists while making small, soft jumps.
mistakes: Avoid high jumps and stiff landings.
tips: Start with short intervals to establish rhythm.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Stand behind the kettlebell, hinge at your hips and grasp the handle with both hands.
Hike it back, extend your hips to send it forward, then hinge again as it returns.
mistakes: Avoid lifting the kettlebell mainly with your arms.
tips: Learn a controlled hip hinge before adding speed.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad, grasp the bar and sit tall with feet planted.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest, then let your arms extend slowly.
mistakes: Avoid pulling behind your neck or swinging backward.
tips: Keep your elbows moving down toward your sides.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells by your sides and elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to a comfortable height, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Avoid shrugging or using a bounce from your legs.
tips: Choose a load that allows a smooth arc.

name: Seated leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine so your knee aligns with its pivot and the lower pad rests above your heels.
Bend your knees against the pad, then extend them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid lifting your hips from the seat.
tips: Secure the thigh pad before starting.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees align with the machine pivot and the pad rests above your ankles.
Straighten your knees with control, then lower the pad slowly.
mistakes: Avoid kicking the weight or slamming the stack.
tips: Keep your back against the support.

name: Leg press
instructions: Sit with your back and pelvis supported and feet flat on the platform.
Release the safety stops, bend your knees within a controlled range and press back up.
mistakes: Avoid lowering until your pelvis curls away from the pad.
tips: Keep your knees aligned with your feet.

name: Lying leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and your abdomen braced.
Lift your legs, then lower them only as far as you can without arching your back.
mistakes: Avoid using momentum or losing trunk control.
tips: Bend your knees to reduce the demand.

name: Dumbbell lunge
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells by your sides and step forward with one foot.
Bend both knees to lower your body, then push through the front foot to return.
mistakes: Avoid stepping onto a very narrow line.
tips: Keep the front foot fully planted.

name: Lying leg curl
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with knees aligned to its pivot and the pad above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your hips, then lower the pad slowly.
mistakes: Avoid lifting your hips away from the bench.
tips: Use a comfortable knee range.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands beneath your shoulders.
Bring one knee toward your chest, return it and alternate sides.
mistakes: Avoid bouncing your hips high or sagging your back.
tips: Begin slowly and maintain your plank position.

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell securely overhead with both hands and a braced trunk.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, then straighten your arms.
mistakes: Avoid arching your back to move the weight.
tips: Keep the load light enough to control overhead.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable and hold the handle against your chest.
Press your hands forward without turning your torso, pause and return.
mistakes: Avoid rotating toward the cable as your arms extend.
tips: Use a stable stance and breathe through the hold.

name: Pec deck fly
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are near chest height and your back is supported.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest, then open slowly.
mistakes: Avoid forcing your shoulders far behind your body.
tips: Keep a small bend in your elbows.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders and legs extended.
Brace your trunk and hold a straight, comfortable line while breathing steadily.
mistakes: Avoid letting your hips sag.
tips: Use your knees as a support if needed.

name: EZ-bar preacher curl
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms supported on the pad and take a secure grip.
Curl the bar upward, then lower it slowly without forcing your elbows straight.
mistakes: Avoid lifting your upper arms off the pad.
tips: Keep the bottom position controlled.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Take a secure grip on the bar and hang with your shoulders controlled.
Pull your body upward, then lower slowly to the starting position.
mistakes: Avoid kicking your legs for momentum.
tips: Use assistance when needed to maintain control.

name: Push-up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your body as one unit, then press the floor away.
mistakes: Avoid sagging through your lower back.
tips: Use an elevated hand support to reduce difficulty.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand with a bar held close to your thighs and knees softly bent.
Move your hips backward as the bar travels close to your legs, then stand tall.
mistakes: Avoid rounding your back or forcing the bar to the floor.
tips: Stop the descent when you can no longer keep the hinge controlled.

name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward with soft knees and dumbbells hanging beneath your shoulders.
Raise your arms out to the sides with a slight elbow bend, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Avoid jerking your torso upward.
tips: Use a lighter load than for a row.

name: Reverse crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent and arms resting on the floor.
Curl your pelvis gently toward your ribs, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your legs to lift your hips.
tips: Keep the movement small and controlled.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells by your sides, then step one foot backward.
Lower with both knees bending, then press through your front foot to return.
mistakes: Avoid pushing mainly from the rear foot.
tips: Keep your stance wide enough for balance.

name: Cable overhead triceps extension
instructions: Face away from a cable while holding a rope behind your head with elbows bent.
Extend your elbows to move your hands overhead, then return slowly.
mistakes: Avoid arching your lower back.
tips: Keep your trunk stable as your elbows move.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Secure your feet and hold the handle with relaxed shoulders and straight wrists.
Drive with your legs, lean back slightly and pull the handle toward your lower ribs; return arms, trunk and then knees.
mistakes: Avoid pulling early with your arms before the leg drive.
tips: Practice the sequence slowly before increasing pace.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet supported and your trunk slightly reclined.
Turn your upper body gently from side to side while keeping the motion controlled.
mistakes: Avoid rounding and twisting abruptly under load.
tips: Keep your feet down while learning the movement.

name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Sit with the pads resting above your knees and the balls of your feet on the platform.
Raise your heels, pause and lower them slowly.
mistakes: Avoid bouncing through the bottom position.
tips: Keep pressure through the balls of your feet.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit with feet supported and hold the cable handle with your trunk upright.
Pull toward your lower ribs, then extend your arms under control.
mistakes: Avoid rocking your torso back and forth.
tips: Let your shoulder blades move without shrugging.

name: Side plank
instructions: Lie on one side with your elbow below your shoulder and legs stacked or staggered.
Lift your hips and hold your trunk steady while breathing.
mistakes: Avoid letting your shoulder collapse toward your ear.
tips: Support yourself on bent knees for an easier variation.

name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a softly bent knee and hold dumbbells near your sides.
Hinge at your hip as the other leg reaches backward, then return to standing.
mistakes: Avoid opening your pelvis toward the lifted leg.
tips: Use a nearby support until your balance is steady.

name: EZ-bar skull crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench with an EZ-bar above your chest and a secure grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward the area above your head, then straighten your arms.
mistakes: Avoid dropping the bar toward your face.
tips: Use a light load and a spotter when appropriate.

name: Sled push
instructions: Hold the sled handles, lean forward from your ankles and brace your trunk.
Push the sled with steady alternating steps while keeping your spine controlled.
mistakes: Avoid letting your back collapse as fatigue builds.
tips: Start with a light sled on a clear surface.

name: Smith machine incline press
instructions: Position an incline bench under the Smith bar so the bar path aligns comfortably with your upper chest.
Unrack, lower the bar slowly and press upward; re-engage the hooks after the set.
mistakes: Avoid a bench position that forces your shoulders behind an uncomfortable bar path.
tips: Set the safety stops before lifting.

name: Stair climber
instructions: Step onto the stationary machine and begin at a low speed.
Climb with steady steps, using the handrails lightly for balance.
mistakes: Avoid hanging your body weight from the rails.
tips: Keep your torso upright and look ahead.

name: Running
instructions: Begin with an easy walk or jog on a clear route or running surface.
Run at a manageable pace with relaxed shoulders and comfortable strides.
mistakes: Avoid forcing a pace that immediately disrupts your control.
tips: Increase effort gradually.

name: Dumbbell step-up
instructions: Stand facing a stable step with dumbbells by your sides and place one foot fully on top.
Press through that foot to stand on the step, then lower with control.
mistakes: Avoid pushing mostly from the trailing foot.
tips: Choose a step height that lets you keep your balance.

name: Sumo deadlift
instructions: Stand close to the bar with a wide stance and toes angled comfortably outward; grip inside your knees.
Brace, push through the floor to stand, then bend hips and knees to return the bar.
mistakes: Avoid letting your knees fall inward.
tips: Keep the bar close and reset before the next repetition.

name: T-bar row
instructions: Straddle the secured bar, hinge your hips and grasp the handle with a braced trunk.
Pull the handle toward your torso, then lower with control.
mistakes: Avoid jerking your torso upward to move the load.
tips: Keep your back position consistent.

name: Treadmill walking
instructions: Attach the treadmill safety clip and start at a slow belt speed.
Walk naturally with an upright posture, then slow the belt before stepping off.
mistakes: Avoid stepping onto a fast-moving belt.
tips: Use the rails for balance rather than hanging on them.

name: Toe-touch crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised and your arms reaching upward.
Curl your shoulders toward your feet, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Avoid swinging your arms to create momentum.
tips: Reach only as far as you can without straining your neck.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with elbows near your sides and a secure grip on the handle.
Straighten your elbows to press the handle down, then return slowly.
mistakes: Avoid moving your whole shoulder to push the load.
tips: Keep your upper arms near your torso.

name: Barbell upright row
instructions: Stand with a bar in front of your thighs and take a comfortable grip.
Lift it close to your body with elbows leading, stopping at a comfortable shoulder height, then lower.
mistakes: Avoid pulling into shoulder discomfort.
tips: Use a light load and an unrestricted grip width.

name: V-up
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your trunk and legs toward each other, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Avoid throwing your arms to create momentum.
tips: Bend your knees or shorten the movement if needed.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a short distance forward.
Slide down to a comfortable knee bend and hold while breathing steadily.
mistakes: Avoid allowing your knees to collapse inward.
tips: Use a shallower position to reduce the demand.
